Pemirolast potassium may be used in the management of asthma in children in the following oral doses: • 1 to 4 years: 2.5 mg twice daily after food • 5 to 10 years: 5 mg twice daily after food • 11 years and above: use adult doses, see above For allergic rhinitis, the above doses are halved. Pemirolast potassium 0.1% eye drops can be used four times daily in children over 3 years with allergic conjunctivitis.
